name: Patriotic Millionaires UK: latest news
note: The group's own posts: letters, statements, polls and events, naming members and signatories. Recommended by the group (Jess Beckett, November 2026). Board members are not members of the organisation: a board member's own statement is needed, not the group's.

name: Patriotic Millionaires US: in the news
note: Press coverage of the group and its members (press type 396, in the news); the URL recorded is the outlet's article. Press releases (type 395) are the group's own statements and are not read. Recommended by the group.

name: Patriotic Millionaires Canada: media
note: Interviews, opinion pieces and podcasts by members (English and French), mostly on outlets' own sites. Recommended by the group.

name: Patriotic Millionaires US: meet the millionaires (members, allies, staff)
note: A roster of 189 people pages (members, allies, board, staff), not articles: each item is a person's page on the group's site. Membership is not a statement; each person needs their own words about a wealth tax, found on the page or elsewhere. Suggested by the group (Jess Beckett, November 2026).
